phase: formula-pass (blind; stage-A packet only; no claims seen)

formulaIdentity.normalization: Upper-case source; slash synonyms ('AQUA / WATER', 'CI 60730 / EXT. VIOLET 2', 'PARFUM / FRAGRANCE') are single entries; names cited in title case; normalized positions = packet positions (ID-2).

surfactants.definingAnionic: Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 (strong anionic, ether/sulfonate type)
notCleansing: Trideceth-10 @18, Trideceth-3 @19 (ethoxylate emulsifiers/thickeners; no C3 cleansing class)

actives: Salicylic Acid @20 (not a recognized dandruff active alone)

exposure.otherNotes: Violet colourant CI 60730 / Ext. Violet 2 @7 (toning dye); Acetic Acid @16, Fumaric Acid @22, Citric Acid @25 acids; Hexylene Glycol @26

wLine.plausibility: Sodium Benzoate @11: (i) SLES @2 before; (ii) entries 12-26 contain no C3 cleansing surfactant (Trideceth-n are in no cleansing class), no alkanolamide (Cocamide MEA @9 is before) and no pearlizing wax (Glycol Distearate @3 is before)

formulaFacts.mildBase: not met: prominent strong anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 chassis, Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 with prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine @5 and Coco-Betaine @10, no reinforcing strong anionic (C3, C4, C1). Cocamide MEA @9 is a foam booster, not a buffer.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: C2 met exactly as in its settled example - early (prominent) Dimethicone @6, cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @8, pearlizing Glycol Distearate @3, and a C2-list humectant (Sodium Hyaluronate @13), plus a late Amodimethicone @23. Multiple complementary systems (C2, Section 5).

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate - dimethicone plus guar plus a late amodimethicone
weightPotential.persistence: moderate - silicones persistent, no lipid/second polymer reinforcement
weightPotential.counterevidence: Two silicones and a guar converge; amodimethicone is a substantive amino-silicone.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: W1 applies: (a) C1 sulfate chassis with prominent buffers, cleansingStrength moderate; (b) deposition is exactly silicone + cationic guar + late amodimethicone; (c) no further persistent family converges (no payload lipid, no second cationic, no film former, no protein; Carbomer is excluded) -> moderate.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W1's conditions all hold and there is no rich architecture (no payload lipid, so no W-RICH). Not low: silicone + guar are two persistent depositing families (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Silicone shares unknown; dimethicone is early (@6)
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: W1 set (Dimethicone @6 + guar @8 + late Amodimethicone @23) on a buffered SLES base, no further converging family (W1, 6.6). Neighbor high.

careDirection.limitation: Formula-only; a violet toning dye (CI 60730 @7) suggests a colour-correcting role that is outside the focus vocabulary until claims are seen

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Prominent violet dye; acidic system (acetic/fumaric/citric) and silicones could support shine if positioned
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): no claim direction; formula compatible with shine (silicone smoothing, acids). Placeholder general until claims.

usageRole.rationale: PROVISIONAL: default regular; frequent possible with frequency wording (U2). Toning-dye usage limits (if any) are not U-triggers.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: PROVISIONAL: CSA formula half met via listed prominent Sodium Hyaluronate @13 (E4 humectant; prominent only because fragrance is listed last); no comfort-list route; MB excluded (prominent SLES). targeted needs SC1 positioning.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: no Piroctone Olamine, Climbazole or Selenium Sulfide; Salicylic Acid @20 alone does not count (Section 11).

uncertainties: Weight confidence kept moderate (not high) although W1 is a settled case: early Dimethicone @6 plus two silicones keep high a realistic neighbor.
